events.title: Finland Joins NATO as 31st Member
events.description: Finland formally accedes to NATO, ending more than 75 years of military non-alignment. Triggered by Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, Finland's accession doubles the length of NATO's land border with Russia, fundamentally reshaping the strategic map of northern Europe.

events.title: Sudan Civil War Erupts Between Army and RSF
events.description: Armed conflict erupts between Sudan's regular army (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, starting in Khartoum and spreading to Darfur and other regions. The fighting triggers one of the world's worst humanitarian crises, with thousands killed and over 8 million people displaced.

events.title: Niger Military Coup Deposes President Bazoum
events.description: Niger's Presidential Guard stages a coup deposing elected President Mohamed Bazoum and installing General Abdourahamane Tchiani as leader. ECOWAS, France and the United States condemn the takeover. France and the US subsequently withdraw all military forces from the country.

events.title: Hamas October 7 Attack on Southern Israel
events.description: Hamas launches an unprecedented cross-border assault from Gaza, killing approximately 1,200 Israelis and taking 251 hostages in kibbutzim and at the Nova music festival. The deadliest day for Jewish people since the Holocaust. Israel declares a state of war.

events.title: Israel Launches Ground Operation in Gaza
events.description: IDF begins a large-scale ground offensive into northern Gaza following weeks of air campaign, targeting Hamas tunnel infrastructure and command centres. UN warns of catastrophic humanitarian conditions as over one million people are displaced in the first week.

events.title: Panama Canal Cuts Daily Transits Due to Severe Drought
events.description: The Panama Canal Authority reduces the maximum number of daily vessel transits from 36 to 18 due to critically low Gatun Lake water levels caused by El Niño drought. Hundreds of vessels queue on both sides of the canal with waiting times of up to three weeks, disrupting global supply chains.

events.title: Houthi Attacks on Red Sea Commercial Shipping Begin
events.description: Yemen's Houthi movement begins targeting commercial vessels in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, claiming solidarity with Palestinians in Gaza. Major carriers including Maersk, MSC and CMA CGM announce diversions of ships to the longer Cape of Good Hope route.

events.title: Global Container Shipping Rates Surge Amid Red Sea Crisis
events.description: Container shipping rates rise more than 200% as Houthi attacks force vessels to divert around the Cape of Good Hope, adding 10–14 days and significant additional costs per voyage. The Drewry World Container Index hits its highest level since 2022.

events.title: OPEC+ Extends Voluntary Oil Production Cuts
events.description: OPEC+ members led by Saudi Arabia and Russia announce an extension of voluntary oil production cuts totalling around 2.2 million barrels per day into 2024, aiming to support prices amid weaker-than-expected demand and rising non-OPEC supply.

events.title: China Coast Guard Uses Water Cannons on Philippine Vessels at Scarborough Shoal
events.description: China Coast Guard vessels deploy water cannons against Philippine supply boats heading to BRP Sierra Madre at Second Thomas Shoal, injuring Filipino sailors. The Philippines condemns the action as a violation of international law and activates US-Philippines Mutual Defence Treaty consultations.

events.title: Change Healthcare Ransomware Attack Disrupts US Pharmacies
events.description: A ransomware attack by the ALPHV/BlackCat group strikes Change Healthcare, a UnitedHealth Group subsidiary processing approximately 15 billion healthcare transactions annually. US pharmacies are unable to process insurance claims for weeks, delaying prescriptions for millions of Americans.

events.title: MV Rubymar Sinks in Red Sea After Houthi Missile Strike
events.description: British-owned bulk carrier MV Rubymar sinks in the Red Sea two weeks after being struck by a Houthi anti-ship missile on 18 February 2024, becoming the first vessel sunk in the Red Sea conflict. The ship was carrying 21,000 tonnes of fertiliser.

events.title: Sweden Joins NATO as 32nd Member
events.description: Sweden joins NATO after Hungary approves its membership application, completing the Nordic security bloc within the alliance. Sweden's accession is described as the most significant shift in European security architecture in decades and strengthens NATO's dominance in the Baltic Sea.

events.title: Iran Launches Operation True Promise Against Israel
events.description: Iran fires approximately 300 drones, cruise missiles and ballistic missiles at Israeli territory in its first-ever direct attack on Israel. Around 99% are intercepted by Israeli, US, Jordanian and British defences. Iran cites retaliation for an Israeli airstrike on its consulate in Damascus.

events.title: Israel Conducts Retaliatory Airstrikes Near Isfahan
events.description: Israel launches limited airstrikes near Isfahan — its first direct strike on Iranian territory — in retaliation for Iran's April 14 drone and missile barrage. The strike targets air defence radar systems. Iran initially describes the damage as minimal.

events.title: Philippines and US Hold Largest-Ever Balikatan Military Exercises
events.description: The Philippines and United States conduct Balikatan 2024, their largest-ever joint military exercises involving more than 16,000 troops. For the first time, live-fire drills are conducted near the northern Philippines facing the Taiwan Strait. China condemns the exercises as destabilising.

events.title: China PLA Launches Joint Sword-2024A Exercises Near Taiwan
events.description: China's PLA launches Joint Sword-2024A military exercises encircling Taiwan following the inauguration of President Lai Ching-te. The exercises involve naval vessels, combat aircraft and missile units practising blockade and precision strike scenarios around the island.

events.title: North Korea and Russia Sign Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Treaty
events.description: North Korea and Russia sign a comprehensive strategic partnership treaty during Putin's state visit to Pyongyang, pledging mutual military assistance if either party faces armed aggression. The treaty mirrors NATO's Article 5 mutual defence clause and includes defence industrial cooperation.

events.title: Venezuela Presidential Election Results Disputed Amid Fraud Allegations
events.description: Venezuela's electoral authority declares Nicolas Maduro the winner of the presidential election by a narrow margin. The opposition presents voting tallies showing challenger Edmundo Gonzalez won decisively. The United States, European Union and most Latin American governments refuse to recognise the official result.

events.title: Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina Resigns and Flees Amid Mass Protests
events.description: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigns and flees Bangladesh by helicopter to India as mass protests over public sector job quotas escalate into a broader anti-government uprising. An interim government is subsequently formed under Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus.

events.title: Ukraine Launches Surprise Ground Incursion into Russia's Kursk Oblast
events.description: Ukrainian armed forces launch an unexpected cross-border ground offensive into Russia's Kursk Oblast, capturing dozens of settlements. It is the first occupation of Russian sovereign territory by a foreign army since World War II. Ukraine frames the operation as establishing a buffer zone.

events.title: Myanmar Resistance Forces Capture Lashio
events.description: Myanmar's Brotherhood Alliance resistance coalition captures Lashio, the largest city in northern Shan State and headquarters of the military's Northeast Command. The fall of Lashio is one of the most significant territorial losses for the junta since its February 2021 coup.

events.title: North Korea Deploys Troops to Support Russia in Ukraine
events.description: North Korea deploys approximately 10,000–12,000 troops to Russia to assist in operations in Ukraine, confirmed by US, South Korean and Ukrainian officials. Analysts describe it as the first confirmed deployment of North Korean ground forces to a foreign conflict since the Korean War.

events.title: North Korea Tests Hwasong-19 Intercontinental Ballistic Missile
events.description: North Korea test-fires the Hwasong-19 ICBM, which travels approximately 1,000km and reaches an altitude of 7,687km before landing in the sea east of the Korean peninsula after an 86-minute flight. South Korea and the United States condemn the test as a violation of UN Security Council resolutions.

events.title: Salt Typhoon Hackers Breach US Telecommunications Networks
events.description: Chinese state-linked hacking group Salt Typhoon infiltrates multiple major US telecommunications providers including AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile, accessing call records and law enforcement wiretap systems. The FBI and CISA describe it as one of the most significant intelligence breaches in US history.

events.title: Lebanon-Israel Ceasefire Takes Effect
events.description: A 60-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah takes effect, brokered by the United States and France. IDF begins phased withdrawal from southern Lebanon. Hezbollah agrees to redeploy forces north of the Litani River under UN Security Council Resolution 1701.

events.title: Russia Launches Major Coordinated Strikes on Ukrainian Power Grid
events.description: Russia launches one of its most extensive attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, targeting power stations, substations and heating plants across multiple regions ahead of winter. DTEK and Ukrenergo report critical damage leaving millions without electricity and heating.

events.title: Gaza Ceasefire Phase 1 Enters Force
events.description: Phase 1 of a ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas enters force, pausing the 15-month conflict. The US, Qatar and Egypt-brokered deal includes the release of Israeli hostages held in Gaza in exchange for Palestinian prisoners held by Israel.

events.title: M23 Rebels Seize Goma in Eastern DR Congo
events.description: M23 rebels, backed by Rwanda, seize Goma — capital of North Kivu province and eastern DRC's largest city — in a rapid offensive. Hundreds of thousands of civilians are displaced. The UN Security Council holds an emergency session and warns of catastrophic humanitarian consequences.

events.title: UN Security Council Emergency Session Fails to Prevent US-Iran Military Confrontation
events.description: An emergency session of the UN Security Council called by Russia and China to prevent military action against Iran ends without agreement, as the US and UK veto a draft resolution demanding a halt to strike preparations. Diplomatic observers warn a military confrontation is now imminent.

events.title: Iran Vows 'Crushing Response' to Any US-Israeli Military Attack
events.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei warns that any US or Israeli military attack on Iranian soil will be met with a 'crushing and devastating response' targeting the full range of US assets in the Middle East. The statement comes amid a final breakdown in indirect diplomatic contacts.

events.title: US Congress Briefed on Imminent Military Action Against Iran's Nuclear Programme
events.description: Senior US administration officials brief Congressional leaders in a closed session on plans for military action against Iran's nuclear infrastructure. Lawmakers are informed that diplomatic options have been exhausted and that operational planning with Israel is complete.

events.title: Iran confirms killing of Ayatollah Khamenei amid air strikes
events.description: Iranian state media confirms that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei has been killed on the first day of large‑scale U.S. and Israeli air strikes on Iran. The combination of decapitation of the leadership and external military pressure marks an acute political and security crisis for the Iranian state.

events.title: US and Israel see opportunity in vulnerable Iran regime
events.description: Analysis by Jeremy Bowen argues that Washington and Tel Aviv view the current moment as a strategic opportunity, with Iran's regime weakened by economic crisis and recent protests. This perception may encourage continued military pressure despite high regional risks.

events.title: USS Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group Ordered to Persian Gulf as Iran Standoff Escalates
events.description: The US Navy orders the USS Gerald R. Ford carrier strike group to the Persian Gulf as the diplomatic standoff with Iran over its nuclear programme reaches a critical point. The deployment signals Washington's readiness to use military force if negotiations collapse.

events.title: Analysis: Iran faces strategic shock after supreme leader killed
events.description: BBC correspondent Lyse Doucet assesses the political shock to Iran following the killing of its supreme leader, arguing that Tehran has long prepared for such a contingency. The report suggests the Islamic Republic will move quickly to demonstrate a succession plan and continuity of governance.

events.title: Iran reels from killing of supreme leader, seeks to project control
events.description: The killing of Iran’s supreme leader has delivered a major shock to the Islamic Republic, prompting urgent efforts by remaining officials to demonstrate continuity and preparedness. The leadership transition poses significant risks of internal instability and escalatory responses abroad.

events.title: Impact of Iranian supreme leader’s killing on regime stability
events.description: The reported killing of Iran’s supreme leader is assessed as a major shock to the Islamic Republic, prompting efforts by authorities to demonstrate continuity and control. The succession process and regime response will be critical indicators of Iran’s political stability in the near term.

events.title: Iranian regime struggles to project control under US-Israel strikes
events.description: Iran's remaining leadership is described as operating in crisis mode while attempting to project security and continuity amid ongoing US and Israeli strikes. The situation raises questions about the regime's ability to maintain internal control if pressure intensifies.

events.title: Iranian leadership under pressure as strikes continue
events.description: Iran’s ruling establishment remains formally intact but is operating in crisis mode as US and Israeli strikes persist. The leadership is focused on projecting control and deterrence while facing questions over its ability to sustain governance and command in a protracted conflict.

events.title: Iranian drone crashes in Kuwait
events.description: Video footage appears to show an Iranian drone on fire before crash-landing inside Kuwaiti territory. The incident underscores spillover risks from the Iran conflict and raises concerns about Kuwaiti airspace security.

events.title: Trump warns of likely further US casualties in Iran conflict
events.description: President Donald Trump has warned in a video statement that additional US fatalities are likely as the conflict with Iran continues. The message signals expectations of sustained combat operations and potential domestic political repercussions from rising casualty figures.

events.title: Iran Fires Ballistic Missiles at Haifa and Tel Aviv in Opening Retaliation
events.description: Iran's IRGC launches a salvo of ballistic missiles targeting Haifa and Tel Aviv in the first Iranian retaliatory strike after the US-Israel campaign began. Israel's Arrow-3 and Iron Dome systems intercept the majority; limited impact reported in Haifa's port district.

events.title: Kuwaiti air defences down six US F-15 jets
events.description: Video evidence and US statements indicate that six US F-15 fighter jets were mistakenly shot down by Kuwaiti air defences over Kuwait, with all crew reported in stable condition. The incident exposes serious identification and coordination failures within allied air defense networks during heightened regional tensions.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Shipping Traffic Plummets as Iran War Disrupts Oil Routes
events.description: A timelapse analysis of maritime tracking data shows shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has dropped sharply as the US-Israel military campaign against Iran disrupts the world's most critical oil chokepoint. Major tanker operators suspend bookings. Brent crude surges past $110 per barrel.

events.title: Analysis of strategy to decapitate Iran's leadership
events.description: A security analysis explores the apparent strategy behind targeted strikes that have killed much of Iran's senior leadership. The piece assesses potential succession scenarios and the implications for regime cohesion and regional stability.

events.title: Iran threatens to close Strait of Hormuz oil corridor
events.description: Tehran has warned it will "set fire" to ships attempting to use the Strait of Hormuz, raising the prospect of a partial or full closure of the vital global oil transit route. Such action would severely disrupt energy markets and escalate regional confrontation.

events.title: Uncertain trajectory of ongoing Middle East war
events.description: Reporting underscores the unpredictability of the outcome of an ongoing Middle East conflict, noting that combatants have clear end‑state preferences but no evident pathway to a resolution. The assessment suggests continued fighting and strategic uncertainty in the near term.

events.title: Uncertain trajectory of war involving Iran, US and Israel
events.description: Analysts note that the outcome and endgame of the war involving Iran, the US, and Israel remain highly unpredictable. Combatants are articulating preferred end states, but the conflict’s direction and escalation risks are still unclear.

events.title: Uncertain trajectory of Iran war alarms combatants
events.description: Analysis notes that participants in the Iran conflict are unsure how the war will conclude, even as each side maintains preferred end-state narratives. The unpredictability raises escalation risks and complicates diplomatic off-ramps.

events.title: Uncertain trajectory of Iran war alarms regional actors
events.description: Analysis from the region underscores that the course and outcome of the Iran war remain highly unpredictable, even as fighters on the ground articulate their desired end states. The strategic ambiguity complicates planning for regional governments and external stakeholders.

events.title: Hezbollah attack on Israel pulls Lebanon into new war
events.description: Hezbollah has launched attacks on Israel in support of Iran, prompting Israeli airstrikes and renewed mass displacement inside Lebanon. The move deepens Lebanon's isolation and exposes the country to intensified military retaliation and internal political backlash.

events.title: Food shortages feared in Tehran amid prolonged war
events.description: Residents in Tehran report growing concerns over food availability and rising prices as continued strikes hit the capital during the war. The situation signals mounting pressure on Iran's civilian population and supply chains as hostilities persist.

events.title: Gulf states assess response to Iranian retaliatory strikes
events.description: Gulf monarchies are debating their political and security response after Iranian retaliatory strikes damaged their reputation as safe, stable hubs. The deliberations underscore rising regional pressure to deter further Iranian action while preserving investor confidence.

events.title: US-Israel Airstrikes Across Iran Documented at Scale
events.description: Footage from multiple cities across Iran documents the scale of ongoing US-Israeli airstrikes on Iranian military installations, missile storage sites and nuclear-related infrastructure. Strikes have been confirmed in Tehran, Isfahan, Natanz, Bushehr and Tabriz. International humanitarian agencies warn of civilian casualties.

events.title: Operation Epic Fury: US-Israel Launch Opening Strikes on Iran Nuclear Sites
events.description: US B-2 stealth bombers and Israeli F-35s conduct coordinated strikes on Iran's nuclear enrichment facilities at Natanz, Fordow and Isfahan in the opening night of what Pentagon officials call Operation Epic Fury. The strikes mark the beginning of an open military campaign against Iran's nuclear programme.

events.title: Heavy Fighting Reported Along Israel-Lebanon Border as Ceasefire Collapses
events.description: BBC journalists report heavy gunfire along the Israel-Lebanon border as the November 2024 ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah effectively collapses. Cross-border exchanges involve anti-tank missiles, drones and artillery on both sides of the Blue Line frontier.

events.title: Analysis of Trump's evolving war messaging on Iran
events.description: BBC analysis tracks how President Trump's public messaging on the Iran war has shifted during his second term. Changes in tone and objectives are examined for their impact on domestic opinion and alliance cohesion.

events.title: Iran Supreme Leader Khamenei Dies as US-Israel Campaign Continues
events.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei dies amid the ongoing US-Israel military campaign against Iran. His death marks the most significant political rupture in Iran since the 1979 revolution and throws the Islamic Republic's leadership into crisis during active wartime conditions.

events.title: US-Israel attacks on Iran continue amid Iranian retaliation
events.description: US and Israeli forces have sustained attacks on Iran for a fifth consecutive day, while Iran conducts retaliatory strikes against Israel and targets across the Gulf. The ongoing exchanges signal an entrenched interstate conflict with high escalation risks.

events.title: Pentagon releases video of US torpedo sinking Iranian warship
events.description: The US Department of Defense has published footage purportedly showing a torpedo strike from a US vessel sinking an Iranian warship in the Indian Ocean. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth framed the action as part of ongoing US military operations against Iran's naval assets.

events.title: Assessment of depleted weapons stockpiles in Iran conflict
events.description: BBC analysis explores how shrinking weapons stockpiles among key actors affect the trajectory and sustainability of the ongoing conflict involving Iran. While not decisive alone, logistical and munitions constraints are highlighted as an increasingly significant factor in operational planning.

events.title: US Senate fails to curb Trump war powers on Iran
events.description: A US Senate vote has failed to advance a measure aimed at restricting President Trump's authority to conduct military operations against Iran without prior congressional approval. The outcome preserves broad executive discretion over the ongoing Iran conflict and limits legislative oversight.

events.title: Accounts from Venezuelan detention highlight prison conditions
events.description: Recently released prisoners from Venezuelan jails describe harsh conditions and covert methods used to transmit messages outside, including via 'dirty laundry' and chocolate bars. The testimonies underscore ongoing human rights and rule-of-law concerns under the Maduro government.

events.title: Former Venezuelan prisoners describe harsh detention
events.description: Recently released detainees in Venezuela have detailed the conditions under which they were held and the methods used to smuggle messages out of jail. Their accounts underscore continuing human rights and rule-of-law concerns under the current government.

events.title: Sudan’s protracted war persists amid strong arms supply
events.description: Analysis of Sudan’s ongoing conflict notes both sides retain ample weapon supplies and a history of enduring warfare, giving them incentives to keep fighting. The situation remains deeply troubling, with limited prospects for a rapid resolution.

events.title: US submarine reportedly sinks Iranian warship in Indian Ocean
events.description: According to US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, a US submarine has sunk an Iranian warship in the Indian Ocean south of Sri Lanka, with more than 100 personnel believed to be on board. The incident marks a major escalation in direct US-Iran naval hostilities beyond the Gulf region.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish groups in Iraq consider moves into Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq state they have contingency plans to send fighters into Iran, while denying any current cross-border incursions. Their potential involvement could open a new internal front for Tehran amid ongoing conflict.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish groups in Iraq eye crossing into Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq say they have contingency plans to send forces into Iran amid the ongoing war, while denying they have yet acted. Any such move could open a new front and complicate Tehran’s internal security calculations.

events.title: Maritime traffic declines in Strait of Hormuz
events.description: Timelapse imagery shows a measurable decrease in commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The reduced traffic indicates heightened security risks and market concerns over transit through the key oil chokepoint.

events.title: Reduced ship traffic observed in Strait of Hormuz
events.description: Timelapse imagery shows a decline in marine traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. The reduction indicates elevated security risks or precautionary diversions along one of the world’s key energy chokepoints.

events.title: Ship traffic slowdown documented in Strait of Hormuz
events.description: Marine traffic timelapse confirms a decrease in vessel movements through the Strait of Hormuz. The pattern suggests heightened threat perceptions impacting commercial and energy shipping routes.

events.title: Iran threatens closure of Strait of Hormuz to shipping
events.description: Iran has issued threats to "set fire" to vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, raising the prospect of a de facto shutdown of one of the world’s most critical oil chokepoints. Such action would severely disrupt global energy flows and heighten regional military tensions.

events.title: Ecuador military discovers 35m narco-sub in nature reserve
events.description: Ecuadorean troops found a 35-metre drug-trafficking submersible loaded with fuel and ready for deployment in a protected nature reserve. The discovery underscores the sophistication and environmental reach of regional criminal networks.

events.title: Ecuadorian troops seize large narco-sub in reserve
events.description: Ecuador’s military reports discovering a 35-metre-long drug trafficking submersible loaded with fuel and ready for deployment in a protected nature reserve. The find underscores the sophistication and reach of regional narcotrafficking networks.

events.title: Ongoing conflict in Sudan assessed as entrenched
events.description: A BBC analysis highlights Sudan's conflict as particularly entrenched due to abundant weapons supplies and a historical pattern of prolonged warfare. The report suggests both parties have incentives to continue fighting, indicating limited prospects for a near-term political settlement.

events.title: Sudan’s protracted conflict assessed as escalating risk
events.description: Analysis highlights that Sudan’s ongoing war is sustained by strong weapons supplies and entrenched patterns of prolonged conflict. The situation is characterised as particularly troubling, with both sides having incentives to continue fighting, raising risks of regional spillover and humanitarian deterioration.

events.title: Qatar intercepts Iranian missiles and drones over Gulf
events.description: Qatar’s defence ministry reports intercepting 14 Iranian ballistic missiles and four drones, with additional interception-related explosions over Dubai and Manama, and no casualties. The incident underscores active missile and drone threats to Gulf airspace and the operational use of regional air defences.

events.title: Azerbaijan on high alert after Iranian drone strikes
events.description: President Ilham Aliyev condemned drone strikes from Iran as an 'act of terror' and placed Azerbaijan’s armed forces on high alert. The incident risks drawing Baku into the expanding Iran-centered conflict and heightening regional tensions in the South Caucasus.

events.title: Zelensky: Ukraine Will Share Drone Expertise to Counter Iranian UAVs
events.description: Ukraine's President Zelensky says Kyiv will consider sharing its drone interception expertise with the US to help counter Iranian drone attacks, but only if doing so does not deplete Ukraine's own air defence capabilities on the front line against Russia.

events.title: Iran pursues endurance-based deterrence in current war
events.description: Analysts assess that Iran’s war strategy is built on enduring sustained strikes longer than its adversaries can tolerate costs, while maintaining deterrent pressure. This high-risk approach could prolong conflict and increase the threshold for de-escalation.

events.title: Iran pursues endurance-based war strategy
events.description: Analysts assess that Iran’s war strategy is centred on endurance and deterrence, betting it can absorb sustained strikes longer than its adversaries can tolerate political and economic costs. This approach suggests a protracted conflict trajectory with measured escalation.

events.title: Iran pursues endurance-based war and deterrence strategy
events.description: Analysts assess that Iran’s war posture emphasises outlasting adversaries and reinforcing deterrence, betting it can absorb sustained strikes longer than opponents can bear the costs. This approach suggests a protracted confrontation with calibrated escalation rather than quick resolution.

events.title: Iran Adopts Endurance Strategy as US-Israel Strikes Continue
events.description: Analysis from multiple intelligence sources indicates Iran's war strategy centres on endurance and deterrence rather than immediate retaliation, betting that domestic and international pressure will force the US and Israel to halt strikes. The IRGC remains largely intact despite targeted strikes.

events.title: BRICS shows internal divergence over US-Israel attacks on Iran
events.description: Coverage indicates that the BRICS bloc has adopted a more cautious public stance on US-Israel attacks on Iran since India assumed the chair, suggesting internal divisions over how confrontational to be toward Washington and its allies. The muted response reveals limits to BRICS cohesion on major security crises.

events.title: US-Israel-Iran war enters fifth day with widening strikes
events.description: US and Israeli forces continue large-scale attacks on Iran, while Tehran conducts retaliatory strikes against Israel and targets across the Gulf. The sustained exchanges indicate a high-intensity regional war with escalating risks of wider destabilisation.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish groups in Iraq prepare for possible move into Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq say they have contingency plans to send fighters into Iran, while denying any current cross-border deployments. Their preparations highlight the risk of a Kurdish front emerging in the Iran war, potentially complicating both Iraqi and Iranian internal security.

events.title: Kurdish groups in Iraq eye possible ground role in Iran war
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq say they have contingency plans to send fighters into Iran but deny any current cross-border incursions. Their potential involvement could open an additional front and complicate conflict dynamics for Tehran.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish groups in Iraq eye role in Iran war
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq state they have plans to cross into Iran as the war intensifies, while denying they have yet done so. Their potential involvement raises the risk of multi-front pressure on Tehran and internal insurgency dynamics.

events.title: Trump distances himself from Noem after turbulent DHS tenure
events.description: Following growing controversy over her performance as Homeland Security Secretary, President Trump has politically moved to cut his losses on Kristi Noem. The episode underlines instability within US homeland security leadership and potential policy inconsistencies during a period of elevated security challenges.

events.title: Controversial security wall in Cape Town sparks social unrest concerns
events.description: Plans in Cape Town to build a multimillion-dollar "crime wall" along the N2 highway have drawn criticism from nearby shack dwellers, who say it will entrench segregation between rich and poor communities. The project risks inflaming social tensions and perceptions of structural inequality.

events.title: Controversial security wall sparks uproar in Cape Town
events.description: Plans for a multimillion-dollar 'crime wall' along Cape Town’s N2 highway have triggered public backlash, with shack dwellers warning it will entrench segregation between poor and wealthy communities. The project highlights social and political tensions over urban security policy in South Africa.

events.title: Controversial security wall in Cape Town sparks inequality debate
events.description: A planned multimillion-dollar "crime wall" along Cape Town's N2 highway has drawn criticism from local shack dwellers who say it will segregate poor communities from affluent areas. The project raises concerns about securitisation and social division in South Africa's urban policy.

events.title: China unsettled by Iran war’s impact on its global ambitions
events.description: Beijing is increasingly concerned about the strategic and economic implications of the Iran war, which threatens its energy security and Belt and Road interests despite limited immediate shock. Chinese policymakers are reassessing risk exposure to Middle East instability while seeking to preserve long-term regional influence.

events.title: Iran war unsettles China’s regional ambitions
events.description: China is experiencing indirect political and economic ripples from the Iran war despite limited immediate material impact. The conflict complicates Beijing’s strategic plans and investments linked to Middle East stability.

events.title: Iran war unsettles China’s strategic and economic ambitions
events.description: China is beginning to feel indirect impacts from the Iran conflict, particularly regarding energy security and Belt and Road Initiative plans, even as it remains insulated from direct military effects. Beijing’s response will shape its role in Middle East crisis management and great‑power competition.

events.title: Finland Plans to End Decades-Long Ban on Hosting Nuclear Weapons
events.description: Finland signals it plans to lift a decades-old domestic ban on hosting NATO nuclear weapons on its territory, citing the dramatically changed European security environment following Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the subsequent expansion of the NATO-Russia border.

events.title: Fears grow of renewed civil conflict in Ethiopia’s Tigray
events.description: Women who fought in Ethiopia’s previous Tigray war recount the conflict’s devastation as concerns rise that hostilities could resume. The testimonies reflect persistent tensions and the fragility of peace in northern Ethiopia.

events.title: Former fighters warn against renewed civil war in Ethiopia
events.description: Women who fought in Ethiopia’s previous civil war recount the devastation in Tigray as fears mount over a potential resumption of hostilities. Their testimonies highlight persistent grievances and the fragility of peace in northern Ethiopia.

events.title: Ethiopian women veterans warn against renewed civil war
events.description: Former female combatants from Ethiopia’s last civil war recount the devastation of the Tigray conflict amid growing fears of renewed fighting. Their testimonies highlight persistent internal fault lines and the risk of civil instability re-emerging.

events.title: Anthropic to challenge Pentagon supply chain risk designation
events.description: US AI firm Anthropic plans to sue the Pentagon over its designation as a supply chain risk, the first such label for an American company. The dispute could shape future defense procurement policies and regulatory oversight of AI vendors.

events.title: US and Venezuela Resume Diplomatic Ties After Maduro Capture
events.description: The United States and Venezuela agree to resume diplomatic ties after US forces captured President Nicolas Maduro. The two sides will make joint efforts to promote stability in Venezuela. The agreement marks a dramatic shift in US-Venezuela relations after years of sanctions and hostility.

events.title: Israel Strikes Beirut After Issuing Mass Evacuation Warnings
events.description: Israel conducts airstrikes on Beirut's southern suburbs after issuing an unprecedented evacuation warning that triggers mass panic and traffic gridlock across the Lebanese capital. The strikes mark a significant escalation of Israeli operations in Lebanon following the November 2024 ceasefire's collapse.

events.title: Large Explosion Reported in Tehran as US-Israel Strikes Continue
events.description: A large explosion is seen and heard in Tehran as US-Israeli strikes on Iranian military and nuclear infrastructure continue. Al Jazeera journalists document the explosion from their position in the city. Iranian state television acknowledges the incident without providing details.

events.title: US pastors pray over Trump as Iran strikes continue
events.description: Video from the Oval Office shows evangelical pastors praying over US President Donald Trump while US strikes on Iran remain ongoing. The imagery reflects the intertwining of domestic religious constituencies and political support for the administration’s military campaign.

events.title: US-Israel attacks on Iran continue amid mutual strikes
events.description: US and Israeli forces have been conducting air and missile strikes on Iran for five consecutive days, while Iran carries out retaliatory attacks against Israel and targets across the Gulf. The sustained exchanges indicate a high-intensity interstate war with regional spillover risks.

events.title: Analysts warn US that weakening Iran could backfire
events.description: Commentary argues that overly destabilising Iran risks internal fragmentation, broader regional instability, and global economic shocks. The assessment cautions Washington against pursuing strategies that could unintentionally undermine regional order and energy security.

events.title: Controversial crime wall in Cape Town sparks segregation fears
events.description: Cape Town authorities plan a multimillion-dollar security wall along the N2 highway, prompting criticism from nearby shack dwellers who say the project will entrench segregation between poor and wealthy communities. The move has triggered domestic uproar over urban security and inequality.

events.title: Cape Town crime wall plan sparks segregation concerns
events.description: A planned multimillion-dollar security barrier along Cape Town's N2 highway has drawn criticism from shack dwellers who say it will separate poor communities from wealthier areas. The project is fuelling domestic political tensions over inequality and urban security policy.

events.title: Analysis of how Iran war could affect food and fuel prices
events.description: BBC analysis examines how conflict and unrest in Iran and the wider Middle East may disrupt supply chains and energy flows, raising global food and fuel prices. The report underscores the vulnerability of global living costs to sustained instability in key producing and transit states.

events.title: Iran abandons ‘strategic patience’ toward US and Israel
events.description: Tehran has shifted from a policy of calibrated ‘strategic patience’ to open confrontation with the United States and Israel after years of sanctions, covert attacks, and proxy pressure. This change increases the risk of sustained regional conflict and reduces prospects for near-term de-escalation or diplomatic compromise.

events.title: Tehran shifts from strategic patience to open confrontation
events.description: Years of US and Israeli pressure have pushed Iran from a posture of calibrated strategic restraint toward overt regional confrontation. This shift increases the risk of wider escalation across the Middle East and complicates diplomatic de-escalation efforts.

events.title: Analysis: Iran abandons 'strategic patience' posture
events.description: An assessment argues that sustained US and Israeli pressure has pushed Tehran from a doctrine of calibrated restraint to overt regional confrontation. The shift suggests Iran is more willing to accept escalatory risk, increasing the likelihood of broader conflict across the Middle East.

events.title: Iran abandons 'strategic patience' in favor of open confrontation
events.description: Tehran has shifted from a strategy of calibrated restraint to overt regional confrontation after years of pressure from the US and Israel. The change increases the risk of sustained multi-front conflict and miscalculation across the Middle East.

events.title: Iran shifts from restraint to open regional confrontation
events.description: Analysis suggests years of US and Israeli pressure have pushed Iran from a posture of calibrated strategic patience to overt regional confrontation. The shift indicates Tehran’s willingness to accept higher military and economic risks to assert its interests.

events.title: Iranians hold wartime Friday prayers mourning Khamenei
events.description: Large crowds in Iran gathered for the first Friday prayers of the Iran war, mourning Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and chanting anti-US and anti-Israel slogans. The mobilization signals strong regime-directed public sentiment and consolidates domestic support for Iran’s confrontational regional posture.

events.title: Concerns Russia may exploit Ukraine’s Patriot shortages
events.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that more US-made Patriot air defence missiles were expended in three days of the Iran war than in Ukraine since 2022, raising fears of depleted stocks. Analysts question whether Russia will seek to capitalize on Ukraine’s relative air-defence vulnerability as Western systems are diverted.

events.title: Azerbaijan Protests Iranian Strikes Spilling Over Shared Border
events.description: Azerbaijan expresses fury after Iranian military strikes during the ongoing US-Israel campaign spill over into Azerbaijani territory near the southern border. Baku summons Iran's ambassador and demands assurances. The incident raises fears of regional escalation.

events.title: Ukraine to advise Gulf states on countering Shahed drones
events.description: Ukraine will provide expertise to Gulf countries and other partners on countering Iran’s Shahed drones, while insisting the assistance will not degrade its own defences. The move expands Kyiv’s security cooperation footprint and supports regional air-defence adaptation against Iranian UAV threats.

events.title: Russian energy demand rises as Iran war disrupts markets
events.description: Moscow reports a significant increase in global demand for Russian oil and gas amid the war involving Iran, as buyers seek alternative supplies. The International Energy Agency warns that renewed reliance on Russian energy would be both politically and economically risky.

events.title: Russia reports surge in oil and gas demand amid Iran war
events.description: Moscow is seeing a significant increase in global demand for Russian oil and gas as the war involving Iran disrupts energy markets. The International Energy Agency has cautioned that renewed dependence on Russian supplies would be politically and economically risky.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish Forces Prepare Ground Operations Into Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups in exile in northern Iraq tell BBC they are preparing to cross the border into Iran to exploit the US-Israeli military campaign, though they deny having already done so. The groups say they need US-Israeli protection to launch a sustainable uprising.

events.title: Kurdish groups in Iraq consider ground operations into Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq state they have prepared plans to cross into Iran but deny having acted yet. Their potential deployment could open an additional front in the conflict and strain Iran’s internal security posture.

events.title: Exiled Iranian Kurds ready potential incursions into Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition groups based in northern Iraq say they have prepared plans to send fighters into Iran but deny having crossed the border so far. Their posture points to a possible new ground front and internal pressure point for Tehran during the ongoing war.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish groups in Iraq signal readiness for ground ops in Iran
events.description: Iranian Kurdish opposition organisations based in northern Iraq state they have prepared plans to send fighters into Iran, though they deny having crossed the border so far. Their potential mobilisation could open another front in the Iran conflict and strain Baghdad–Tehran relations.

events.title: Iranian Kurdish uprising seen as unlikely without external backing
events.description: Analyst Yerevan Saeed assesses that Iranian Kurdish forces would be unable to sustain an uprising in Iran without military and political protection from the United States and Israel. The assessment underscores Tehran’s persistent internal security advantage and the deterrent effect of potential foreign escalation.

events.title: Israel restricts access to Al-Aqsa during Ramadan
events.description: Israeli authorities have imposed stringent access restrictions to the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in occupied East Jerusalem, leaving the site largely empty on the third Friday of Ramadan. The move heightens tensions around a highly sensitive religious and political flashpoint amid broader regional conflict involving Iran.

events.title: Indonesia to ban social media use for under-16s
events.description: Indonesia plans to prohibit social media and other online platforms for users under 16, citing the need to protect minors from abuse and harmful content. The move represents a significant tightening of digital regulation in the world’s third-largest democracy, with implications for tech firms and civil liberties.

events.title: Iran women’s footballers threatened over anthem protest
events.description: An Iranian state TV presenter publicly threatened members of the Iran women’s national football team after several players did not sing the national anthem at an AFC Cup match. Rights groups are urging FIFA and the AFC to intervene, highlighting intensified coercive pressure on dissent in Iran’s sports sector.

events.title: Europe and Australia deploy military assets to Middle East
events.description: France, Spain, and Australia have deployed military assets to the Middle East following attacks near Cyprus, indicating heightened concern over regional escalation linked to the Iran war. These deployments reflect allied efforts to protect maritime routes, nationals, and strategic interests amid widening instability.

events.title: Analyst downplays likelihood of Kurdish uprising in Iran
events.description: Kurdish affairs analyst Yerevan Saeed assessed that an organized Kurdish uprising in Iran is unlikely without substantial US or Israeli protection. The assessment underscores both the regime’s coercive capacity in Kurdish regions and the constraints on external powers escalating support amid the Iran war.

events.title: Messi criticized for White House event with Trump amid Iran war
events.description: Lionel Messi faced censure after appearing at a White House event where Donald Trump honored Inter Miami and praised US military strength while the United States is engaged in attacks related to the Iran war. The episode illustrates growing politicization of high-profile sports figures in the context of ongoing US–Iran tensions.

events.title: Rising demand for Russian energy amid Iran war
events.description: Moscow reports a significant increase in global demand for Russian oil and gas as the Iran war disrupts regional energy markets and trade routes. The International Energy Agency warns that renewed reliance on Russian supplies is both politically and economically risky for Europe and its partners.

events.title: US deploys PrSM in Iran for first combat use
events.description: US Central Command confirmed the first operational use of the Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) during Operation Epic Fury in Iran. The deployment demonstrates an escalation in US strike capabilities against Iranian targets and serves as a field test for a new generation of long-range precision fires.

events.title: US honours Inter Miami and Messi at White House amid Iran strikes
events.description: Lionel Messi and Inter Miami were honoured at the White House, where Donald Trump praised US military power while Washington continues military operations against Iran. The event highlights the domestic political messaging around US force projection during an ongoing conflict.

events.title: US employs Precision Strike Missile in Iran for first time
events.description: US Central Command confirmed the first operational use of the Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) during Operation Epic Fury in Iran. The deployment signals a qualitative enhancement of US long-range precision-strike capabilities in the region.

events.title: Cape Town security wall project sparks segregation outcry
events.description: A multimillion-dollar crime-prevention wall planned along Cape Town’s N2 highway has triggered public uproar, with shack dwellers and activists arguing it will further segregate poor communities from wealthier areas. The controversy underscores deep socioeconomic divides and governance challenges in South Africa’s Western Cape.

events.title: Analysts warn US that weakening Iran could backfire
events.description: Policy analysis argues that severely destabilising Iran could trigger internal fragmentation, broader regional instability, and global economic shocks, particularly in energy markets. The assessment cautions Washington against maximalist strategies that risk strategic blowback.

events.title: Ukraine regains territory as Trump and Putin cast themselves as peacemakers
events.description: Ukraine has recovered some territory for the first time since 2023 amid reports of sharply rising Russian losses, while Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin each present themselves as peacemakers in the conflict. The narrative battle over war outcomes contrasts with continued kinetic gains for Kyiv on the ground.

events.title: Iranian sailors rescued after US attack on vessel
events.description: Newly released video shows the rescue of Iranian sailors following a US attack on their ship amid the ongoing conflict. The incident highlights both the intensity of US-Iran maritime engagements and persistent risks to commercial and military shipping in the region.

events.title: Houthis weigh intervention in Iran’s regional war
events.description: As the regional conflict intensifies, Houthi leader Abdel-Malik al-Houthi faces a strategic decision over whether to deepen the group’s involvement in Iran’s war. A move to intervene more directly would heighten risks to Red Sea shipping and further entrench the Iran-aligned axis.

events.title: US Iran war costs reach $3.7bn in first 100 hours
events.description: A think tank estimates that US military operations against Iran have cost $3.7 billion in the first 100 hours, with most expenses unbudgeted. The Pentagon is expected to seek additional funding, underscoring the rapid fiscal impact of high-intensity conflict with a major regional power.

events.title: Mass exodus from Middle East air hubs amid Iran war
events.description: Tens of thousands of people are scrambling to leave the Middle East as the Iran war escalates, with wealthy travellers paying up to $200,000 to charter private flights. The surge in departures reflects heightened perceptions of regional insecurity and potential for further escalation.

events.title: US debuts Precision Strike Missile in Iran operation
events.description: US Central Command confirmed the first operational use of the Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) during Operation Epic Fury in Iran. The deployment demonstrates an advanced long-range precision capability and signals US willingness to employ next-generation strike systems in high-intensity conflicts.

The piece highlights the systemic risk of regime-collapse scenarios in a major regional power.

events.description: The US Department of Justice released files summarising allegations by a woman who accuses Donald Trump of a sexual encounter when she was between 13 and 15 years old. The documents could have legal and political implications for Trump’s standing and domestic governance environment.

events.title: Think tank estimates $3.7bn US cost in first 100 hours of Iran war
events.description: A US-based research group estimates that the first 100 hours of the war on Iran have cost the United States approximately $3.7bn, much of it outside existing budgets. The assessment indicates the Pentagon will likely require supplemental funding, with implications for US fiscal and defence planning.

events.title: Mass scramble for flights out of Middle East amid Iran war
events.description: Tens of thousands of people are seeking flights out of the Middle East due to the Iran war, with wealthy travellers paying up to $200,000 for chartered aircraft. events.description: Conflict in the Middle East is raising concerns over disruptions to oil, gas, and particularly food shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, effectively landlocking Gulf states such as Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar. events.description: Sudan’s ongoing conflict is assessed as particularly intractable due to steady weapons supplies and a historical pattern of prolonged warfare on both sides. These factors reduce incentives for compromise and point to a high risk of continued humanitarian deterioration.

events.description: Hungary announces it will expel Ukrainian bank workers after detaining several on suspicion of money laundering, escalating a fierce diplomatic dispute with Kyiv. Budapest's move threatens to further strain EU-Ukraine solidarity as the war with Russia continues.

events.description: Thousands of Syrian refugees are leaving Lebanon and attempting to return to Syria as Israeli airstrikes intensify across Lebanese territory. The movements risk creating a new wave of displacement and humanitarian strain along the Syria-Lebanon border.

events.description: Escalating conflict involving Iran and a drone attack on Azerbaijan have caused additional airspace closures, constraining flight paths for international airlines. events.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum pledged the deployment of 100,000 security personnel to safeguard the upcoming World Cup, highlighting concerns over public safety and international perception. events.description: A drone penetrated air defences and ignited a large fire at an oil installation serving foreign companies in Basra, southern Iraq. The incident underscores the vulnerability of critical energy infrastructure amid regional tensions.

events.description: Cuban authorities announced a fifth fatality following a shootout with a Florida-tagged speedboat whose occupants were accused of plotting terrorist acts in Cuba. The incident highlights ongoing security tensions between Cuba and US-linked actors.

events.description: Witness video verified by the BBC shows a drone crashing close to Dubai Airport amid heightened regional tensions. The incident underscores the vulnerability of critical aviation infrastructure in the UAE.

events.title: Deadly floods in Nairobi kill at least 23
events.description: Heavy rains and flooding in Nairobi have killed at least 23 people, disrupting flights at the capital’s airport and submerging key roads. The event underscores Kenya’s vulnerability to extreme weather and strains local emergency response capacity.

events.title: Flooding in Nairobi kills at least 23 and disrupts airport
events.description: Heavy rains in Nairobi have caused severe flooding, killing at least 23 people and submerging key roads. Flight operations at Nairobi’s main airport have been disrupted, indicating significant humanitarian impact and infrastructure stress.

events.title: Iranian president issues rare apology amid wartime pressures
events.description: Iran’s president has issued an unusual public apology, which analysts interpret as a potential signal of internal political repositioning during the ongoing conflict. The move suggests sensitivity to domestic opinion and possible recalibration within the ruling establishment.

events.title: Iranian ambassador warns UK over deeper role in Iran war
events.description: Iran's ambassador to the UK cautioned London to be 'very careful' about increasing its involvement in the war against Iran. He asserted Iran's right to self-defence if the UK were to directly join US-Israeli military operations.

events.title: Israeli special forces raid in Lebanon leaves dozens dead
events.description: An Israeli special forces operation in a Lebanese village, reportedly conducted to locate 40-year-old remains, resulted in at least 41 people killed and 40 injured according to Lebanon's health ministry. The raid represents a severe escalation of Israeli ground activity on Lebanese territory.

events.title: Nightclub bombing injures over 30 in northern Peru
events.description: A bombing at a nightclub in northern Peru injured more than 30 people amid a reported rise in organised crime and extortion. Analysts link the deteriorating security environment to entrenched government corruption and weak law enforcement.

events.title: UAE signals readiness to confront threats as Iran attacks
events.description: The UAE president stated that the country is prepared to confront threats as Iranian attacks on Gulf states continue. Iran's judiciary chief reversed an earlier apology to Gulf countries and warned of heavy strikes on areas deemed under enemy control.

events.title: Cuba restores power plant after major blackout
events.description: Cuban authorities report successful repair of an electricity plant following a large-scale blackout amid acute pressure on the country’s ageing energy system. Havana attributes the fragility of its power infrastructure in part to a US pressure campaign and oil blockade.

events.title: Satellite images show major damage at Iranian military sites
events.description: New satellite imagery reveals extensive destruction across several Iranian military bases following recent airstrikes. The damage indicates a concerted campaign to degrade Iran's defence infrastructure.

events.title: Child critically injured in Gaza as Israeli strike kills father
events.description: Medical staff in Gaza are attempting to save a girl injured in an Israeli attack that killed her father. The incident highlights the continuing civilian toll of Israeli military operations in the enclave.

events.title: Regional spillover risks from Iran-Israel-US war
events.description: Analysis highlights mounting concern that the week‑old war involving Iran, Israel, and the United States could expand beyond current fronts. Potential spillover scenarios include involvement by regional proxies, direct strikes on neighboring states, and disruption of key maritime routes.

events.title: Concerns grow over regional spillover of Iran war
events.description: The ongoing war involving Iran, Israel and the United States has entered its second week, driving fears of a broader regional escalation. Analysts warn that continued hostilities raise the risk of multi-front conflict and destabilization across the Middle East.

events.title: US denies Iran claim of captured American soldiers
events.description: The Trump administration rejected statements from Iran’s National Security Council that Iranian forces had captured US soldiers and that Washington was disguising the incident as combat deaths. The contradictory claims highlight competing information campaigns amid the Iran-US conflict.

events.title: Israel strikes Tehran oil depots, Gulf infrastructure hit
events.description: Israeli forces reportedly targeted oil depots in Tehran while attacks also struck a desalination plant in Bahrain amid ongoing regional hostilities. Kuwait and Saudi Arabia reported additional attacks as the US president signalled the conflict would continue until Iran's leadership capitulates.

events.title: Trump dismisses need for UK carriers in Iran war
events.description: US President Donald Trump stated that the United States does not need the UK’s aircraft carriers for ongoing operations against Iran, asserting the war is 'already won'. The comment signals confidence in US unilateral capabilities and may strain perceptions of allied coordination.

events.title: Trump says US does not need UK carriers for Iran war
events.description: The US president declared that American forces do not require the UK's aircraft carriers for the ongoing war with Iran, describing the conflict as 'already won'. He dismissed reports that the UK was preparing the HMS Prince of Wales for deployment, highlighting divergent public messaging among allies.

events.title: Trump downplays need for UK carriers in Iran war
events.description: The US president stated that the United States does not require the UK’s aircraft carriers for ongoing operations against Iran, claiming the war is ‘already won’. The remarks dismiss reports about potential UK deployment of HMS Prince of Wales, underscoring US confidence in unilateral capabilities and potential alliance frictions.

events.title: Populist rapper Balendra Shah ousts ex-PM in Nepal vote
events.description: Rapper-turned-politician Balendra Shah is set to unseat Nepal’s former prime minister after general elections, the first since youth-led protests toppled the previous government in September. The outcome reflects strong public demand for political renewal and accountability.

events.title: Gaza fishing sector collapses under Israeli blockade
events.description: Gaza’s fishing industry is nearing collapse as Israeli-imposed maritime restrictions force Palestinian fishermen to risk their lives for minimal catches. The degraded livelihood options are deepening economic hardship and humanitarian pressure in the enclave.

events.title: Gaza fishermen risk lives under Israeli maritime blockade
events.description: Palestinian fishermen in Gaza are risking their lives to work in an Israeli-controlled maritime zone as the enclave's fishing industry collapses. The long-standing Israeli blockade has severely restricted livelihoods and contributed to worsening humanitarian conditions.

events.title: Explosion hits US embassy compound in Oslo
events.description: An explosion struck the US embassy area in Oslo in the early hours of Sunday, with authorities reporting no injuries. Norwegian police have launched an investigation, and the incident raises security concerns around US diplomatic facilities in Europe.

events.title: Explosion hits US embassy in Oslo, no injuries reported
events.description: Norwegian police reported an explosion at the US embassy in Oslo in the early hours of Sunday, with no casualties. The blast raises security concerns around US diplomatic facilities in Europe amid heightened global tensions.

events.title: UN relief chief warns of grave peril in Middle East war
events.description: UN Humanitarian Affairs lead Tom Fletcher described the situation in the Middle East conflict as a 'moment of grave peril' in an interview with the BBC. His remarks signal growing international alarm over the humanitarian and regional security implications of the ongoing war.

events.title: Cyprus protests UK bases after drone strike on RAF Akrotiri
events.description: Cypriot protesters rallied under the slogan 'British Bases Out' following a drone strike targeting the RAF Akrotiri airbase. The incident has intensified local opposition to the long-standing British military presence on the island and raised concerns over spillover from regional conflicts.

events.title: Israel targets Iranian oil facilities as war enters day nine
events.description: Israel carried out its first strikes on Iranian oil infrastructure, hitting four storage facilities and an oil transfer centre in Tehran and Alborz. The attacks triggered large fires and mark an escalation toward Iran's strategic energy assets.

events.title: China warns against regime change in Iran, urges ceasefire
events.description: China publicly opposed any government change in Iran, insisting on respect for Iran's sovereignty. Beijing also called for an immediate halt to military operations in the Middle East, signalling concern over further regional escalation.

events.title: Iran Assembly claims consensus on Khamenei successor
events.description: Iran’s Assembly of Experts announced it has reached consensus on a successor to the late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. Officials said the chosen candidate aligns with Khamenei’s guidance that the leader should be 'hated by the enemy', indicating a likely hardline trajectory.
